headline: PHI @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 5.05 at PIT 3.66, with a projected total of 8.71. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PHI: PHI moved +1.54 runs while PIT moved +0.02, changing the projected margin by +1.52 runs. The projected total climbed +1.56, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -8.4%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Cristopher Sánchez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Brandon Marsh, Kyle Schwarber, Konnor Griffin, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Billy Cook, Adolis García because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
